'''''Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy''''' is a collection of games containing {{III}}, {{VC}}, and {{SA}} for the [[PC]], [[Apple Macintosh|Macintosh]], [[Xbox (console)|Xbox]] and [[PlayStation 2]]. It was released on October 19, [[2005]], in North America and November 4, 2005, in Europe.

After the release of ''[[Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy - The Definitive Edition]]'', the original trilogy was no longer available for purchase on gaming platforms, along with the individual original games for a period of time. The trilogy was later brought back for purchase on the Rockstar Games Store.
